rationale: The assistant correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood system detecting water in the base, advised isolating water and power, and ruled out foam and filter before concluding the leak is internal and needs an engineer to pull the unit. It adapted to the customer's inability to pull out the integrated unit by offering door-seal and under-sink hose checks, though it never acknowledged that constraint or the awkward socket location, and it re-explained E:15 in turn 2. Its 'replace the seal or pump' remark was hedged with 'likely' and routed via an engineer rather than a buy-this-part instruction, so calibration is acceptable; it could have added not to keep resetting it and mentioned Bosch service/warranty status.
